title: Bump comfyui-krea2edit v1.1 -> v1.2.2 (node/weight version mismatch)
description: We already ship the v1.2 identity-edit weights (krea2_identity_edit_v1_2_r128) but pinned the v1.1 NODES (17af8833), so the v1.2 weights have been running on legacy geometry. Bumped node_lock to 223a9383 (v1.2.2). Unlocks the pixel-space source path (vae + source_image), fit_mode, ref_boost / ref_boost_a / ref_boost_mask, GroundedEncode system_prompt, and the ComfyUI ref_latents wrapper tolerance that 0.29 will require. User owns the workflow rewiring + live A/B. Detail in brief.md.
